# The default CGO_ENABLED=0 binary refuses kernel FUSE and points at WebDAV.
! exec drivebridge mount fuse --state $WORK/state
stderr 'unsupported'

# A non-loopback listen without --lan is refused before any service opens.
! exec drivebridge mount webdav --state $WORK/state --listen 0.0.0.0:19099
stderr 'listen_not_allowed'

# No mount is running; status is a read-only projection.
exec drivebridge mount status --state $WORK/state --json
stdout '"alive":false'

# tools/list never exposes agent-writable mount controls.
exec drivebridge capabilities --state $WORK/state --json
stdout 'cli_only'
stdout 'pinax-vault'
! stdout 'mount_start'
! stdout 'mount_stop'
